messages:
sam: FYI I’m scheduling a small change tonight 23:00 UTC that touches runtime v2.11, router v1.6.3 and an API config swap. Target window 30m. Can teams ack deps/rollback criteria?

maya: @sam noted. Which console contract changes?

sam: Only metadata endpoint rename (GET /v1/model/meta -> /v1/models/meta). It's backwards compatible via header opt-in but we need the router to pin older API for 1h fallback.

ian: Runtime patch is a quant kernel swap (FP16 -> int8 fast path). Risk: p99 token latency might spike on long sequences. Canary at 2% initial.

liz: Console UI needs a new field name; will be behind a feature flag. No runtime schema changes.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by sam at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. ID: d-2866543210. Staged rollout: 2% -> 25%@+10m -> 100%@+25m.

maya: Rollback criteria proposal: - error rate > 0.5% above baseline for 5m OR - p99 latency > baseline +150ms for 10m OR - request failures to meta endpoint > 20 in 5m. Also kill the int8 kernel if perf regressions show.

ian: +1. Also add cache-miss rate spike > 10% as trigger (could indicate KV eviction mismatch).

ops-oncall: I’ll be on-call during the window. If anything trips ping #incidents. We can hold traffic at the router level (manual hold) if needed.

sam: Agreed rollback steps: 1) pause rollout via deploy-bot 2) revert router pin to v1.6.2 3) revert runtime image to v2.10 4) toggle console flag off.

deploy-bot: To pause rollout run: ```/deploy pause d-2866543210```
To revert runtime: ```/deploy revert d-2866543210 --service runtime```

liz: I’ll prepare a short release note and keep AM/PM visibility in console. Link: https://internal.redwood/release/2866543210

maya: Last check: are there any schema migrations in DB?

sam: No DB migrations. only header opt-in. Router will add compatibility header: X-Model-Meta: v2

ian: Canary metrics to watch: token-generation p50/p95/p99, model-load failures, kernel OOMs. I'll post a PromQL dashboard link pre-window.

ops-oncall: :+1: I’ll set alert runbook and escalation.

sam: Thanks. If no objections, proceeding with schedule. :thumbsup:
